name: drovox-mobile
description: Drovox Android / iOS app (Capacitor shell around the live store, with native push, back button, share and app links)

scripts.sync: node scripts/configure.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease
